newsitem.title: USA: FemRx wins FDA okay for medical device.
newsitem.headline: FemRx wins FDA okay for medical device.

text.p: FemRx Inc, a maker of medical products for treating gynecologic disorders, on Thursday said the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved the company's new device, called Diva.
Diva is a proprietary laparoscopic morcellator designed to enable gynecologists to remove large tissue masses from the abdomen through small incisions.

"The Diva will be particularly useful for supracervical hysterectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy," George Savage, senior vice president of research and development, said in a statement. "Not only will it improve patient outcomes but it will also lower procedure costs."

Diva will be sold by FemRx in a pack that supplies all tools required for supracervical hysterectomy. It will be integrated into a program that enables surgeons to access training, clinical programs, patient outreach and reimbursement support.
Shares of FemRx were up 1/4 at 2-1/2 by midday.
